## Checklist

- [ ] I did not add remote scripts, analytics, telemetry, or CDN dependencies to generated output.
- [ ] I kept Windows, macOS, and Linux behavior in mind.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for parser/build behavior.
- [ ] I updated README, docs, or translations when user-facing text changed.
- [ ] I used Conventional Commits for commit messages.
